## What managing Logan Square takes.

### Boulevard greystones
The Logan Square Boulevards Historic District carries some of the city's best greystone architecture. Cornices, limestone facades, and century-old roofs make disciplined capital planning essential, it is the heart of our work here.

### Transit-oriented mid-rises
New mid-rise condo buildings along Milwaukee Avenue near the California and Logan Square Blue Line stops bring first-generation boards who need budgets, rules, and reserve studies built from scratch. We specialize in that setup work.

### Two-flat and greystone conversions
Much of Logan Square's condo stock is converted two-to-four-flats, where self-management burns out volunteers fast. Our flat per-unit pricing makes professional management viable at exactly that size.

## Logan Square boards ask us first.

### Do you manage greystones and vintage buildings in Logan Square?
Yes. Vintage masonry buildings, including boulevard greystones, are a specialty. We plan tuckpointing, cornice, and roof cycles years ahead, and we work with masons who know limestone restoration from a quick concrete patch.

### Can CenterPoint take over a newer condo building near the Blue Line?
Yes. Logan Square's transit-oriented buildings are often on their first or second board. We run developer-transition reviews, set up realistic budgets and reserves, and put governance rhythms in place so the association matures smoothly.

### Does CenterPoint manage associations in Logan Square?
Yes. CenterPoint Association Management provides condominium, HOA, and townhome association management in Logan Square, Chicago (ZIP 60618, 60647). Every association gets a dedicated manager, monthly financial reporting, and board support grounded in Illinois association law.

### How much does association management cost in Logan Square?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size, building systems, financial complexity, and service scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing) for what drives the fee.

### How does a Logan Square association switch to CenterPoint?
Plan on a managed 30 to 60 day transition after your board gives notice under its current contract. We retrieve records from the outgoing manager, set up banking and vendor relationships, notify owners, and open board and resident access. ### How should a Logan Square board compare management companies?
Compare at least three firms on the same terms: an active Illinois community association management firm license, a licensed manager, a flat monthly fee in writing, after-hours emergency coverage, and a written transition plan.
